title: 第459章 卡洛琳与凯瑟琳第458章 亵渎之路
slug: 落魄贵族千金被迫成为我的女仆
lines: 而作为堂堂伯爵，叶海想要给名下的几个奴隶注销奴籍，自然用不着亲自跑一趟。
帝国审判庭驻枫叶城的分处，这点面子是绝对要给的。
只需要瓦伦丁带着叶海亲笔签署的领主手令前去，对方便会立刻麻溜地办好。
毕竟说白了，虽然审判庭名义上隶属于帝国中央，但分处的人也是要在叶海的地盘上讨生活的。
他们绝不可能为了几个低贱妓女的奴籍这种屁大点的小事，去得罪一位手握重兵、风头正盛的实权领主。
听到叶海的话，院子里那几个原本眼神麻木、以为只是从一个火坑跳进另一个火坑的女人，全都愣住了。
几秒钟后，当她们终于反应过来“变回自由人”意味着什么时，她们死寂的眼中瞬间爆发出了不可思议的激动光彩。
几个女人当场崩溃，齐刷刷地跪倒在泥地里，抱在一起大哭。
梅布也是颇为激动，她死死握紧了双手，指甲都掐进了肉里。
“伯爵大人……您的恩情深似海，我都不知道该怎么报答您了！”
梅布泪流满面，声音哽咽。
但很快，她像是突然想起了什么事情，赶忙擦去眼泪说道：“大人，我想起来一个事情，或许……或许会对您调查那个邪教有帮助。”
叶海眼神一凝：“说。”
“我听说……主母，啊不对，是那个老鸨和刚才那个死掉的男人，他们之前其实是有一个亲生孩子的，是个十几岁的男孩。”
梅布咽了口唾沫：“但就在大概两个月前，也就是那个男人刚回来不久的时候，那个孩子……突然就不见了。”
“当时老鸨对外宣称，是把孩子送回乡下老家去读书了。”
梅布刚才虽然一直站在一旁，但也壮着胆子瞟见了叶海手里那本册子上的部分内容，尤其是“活埋至亲”那几个触目惊心的字眼。
毕竟叶海翻看的时候，也没有刻意避着她。
她抬起头，看着叶海推断道：
“我想……那个孩子，根本不是被送走了，而是被他给……”
叶海若有所思地点点头：“嗯……意料之中的事情。”
就刚才知道的那些信息来看，这男人必然是活埋了一位至亲，只不过他之前不知道是谁而已。
梅布见叶海似乎误解了她想活的事情，连忙补充道：“可问题是，这男人一年多之前之所以要离开枫叶城，就是为了找到治疗自己儿子的办法。”
“据说他儿子染上了一种怪病，身体逐渐变得僵硬，走路都走不顺畅，当时他找遍了整个枫叶城的医师都没有找到治疗的办法。”
“为此，这男人不惜万里孤身一人前往北境求医，据说在琉璃川公国北边那个兰开斯特公国的境内，有一个很厉害的女巫医。”
“不管什么病她都能治好。”
“虽然不知道他有没有找到那个女巫医，但一个愿意为了儿子不远万里去求医的父亲，怎么会下狠手活埋自己的孩子呢。”
梅布十分难以理解地说道：“我觉得这一点都不合理。”
虽然这个男人她十分痛恨，但这种对家人的情感，梅布还是十分能感同身受的。
毕竟要不是为了让自己的父亲脱离邪教的掌控，她也不会来到城里，最终沦落苦窑。
女巫医？
巫师吗？
枫叶城只会放血的庸医们治不好人在情理之中，那北境的女巫就能治好吗？
没听说巫师在治疗这条道上有什么独特的地方啊。
也不知道那女巫长得好看不好看。
content_en:
As a dignified earl, Ye Hai wanted to cancel the slave status of several slaves under his name, so naturally there was no need to go there in person.
The branch office of the Imperial Tribunal in Maple Leaf City must definitely give this face.
As long as Valentine goes with the lord's warrant signed by Ye Hai, the other party will get it done immediately.
After all, to put it bluntly, although the Tribunal is nominally affiliated with the central empire, the people in the branches also have to make a living on Ye Hai's territory.
They would never offend a powerful and powerful lord with a large number of soldiers for something as trivial as the slavery of a few lowly prostitutes.
Hearing Ye Hai's words, the women in the yard, who had numb eyes and thought they were just jumping from one fire pit to another, were all stunned.
A few seconds later, when they finally realized what it meant to "become a free man", their dead eyes instantly burst into incredible excitement.
Several women collapsed on the spot and fell to their knees in the mud, hugging each other and crying.
Meb was also quite excited. She clenched her hands tightly and dug her nails into her flesh.
"My Lord Count...your kindness is as deep as the ocean. I don't even know how to repay you!"
Meb burst into tears and her voice choked up.
But soon, she seemed to suddenly remember something, and hurriedly wiped away her tears and said, "Sir, I remembered something, maybe... maybe it will be helpful for you to investigate that cult."
"Oh?"
Ye Hai's eyes narrowed: "Say."
"I heard... Mistress, no, it was the old bustard and the man who died just now. They actually had a biological child before, a teenage boy."
Meb swallowed: "But about two months ago, not long after the man came back, the child... suddenly disappeared."
"At that time, the madam announced to the outside world that she had sent the child back to his hometown in the countryside to study."
Although Meibu had been standing aside just now, he still had the courage to glance at some of the contents of the booklet in Ye Hai's hand, especially the shocking words "burying loved ones alive".
After all, Ye Hai didn't deliberately avoid her when he was browsing.
She raised her head, looked at Ye Hai and concluded:
"I think... that child was not sent away at all, but given to him..."
Ye Hai nodded thoughtfully: "Well...it's expected."
Judging from the information just learned, this man must have buried a close relative alive, but he didn't know who it was before.
Seeing that Ye Hai seemed to have misunderstood what she wanted to live, Meibu quickly added: "But the problem is, the reason why this man left Maple Leaf City more than a year ago was to find a way to treat his son."
"It is said that his son contracted a strange disease. His body gradually became stiff and he could not walk smoothly. At that time, he searched all the doctors in Maple Leaf City but could not find a cure."
"For this reason, this man risked thousands of miles to go to the North alone to seek medical treatment. It is said that there is a very powerful witch doctor in the Lancaster Principality to the north of the Liulicuan Principality."
"She can cure any disease."
"Although I don't know if he found the witch doctor, how could a father who was willing to travel thousands of miles to seek medical treatment for his son bury his child alive?"
Meb said incomprehensibly: "I don't think this makes sense at all."
Although she hated this man very much, Meb could still empathize with her feelings for her family.
After all, if it weren't for the purpose of freeing her father from the control of the cult, she would not have come to the city and ended up in a misery.
Witch doctor?
Wizard?
It is reasonable that the quack doctors in Maple Leaf City who can only do bloodletting cannot cure people, but can the witches in the north cure them?
I haven't heard that wizards have anything unique in this way of healing.
I don’t know if the witch is good-looking or not.
